title: Linked Lists
definition: A linked list is a linear collection of nodes containing data and pointers to the next node.
intuition: Allows dynamic memory allocation and O(1) insertions/deletions at known positions.
how_it_works: Nodes are scattered in memory, linked sequentially by pointer references.
when_to_use: When dynamic size is critical and insertion/deletion is frequent.
complexity: Access/Search: O(n), Insertion/Deletion: O(1) if position known
content: A linked list is a linear collection of nodes containing data and pointers to the next node.
